summary: netapp_eseries.santricity deprecates the raid_level alias in na_santricity_volume and host modules in favor of ddp_raid_level, removed in 3.0.0.

answer_card.title: santricity raid_level alias deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `na_santricity_volume` and `nar_santricity_host`, the `raid_level` volume alias is deprecated (removed in 3.0.0). Use **`ddp_raid_level`**.
